rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Connects Claude Code with Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.5 model for cost-effective codebase analysis. Provides tools for whole-codebase scanning, architecture reviews, security vulnerability audits, dependency mapping, and dead code detection using Kimi's 256K token context window. Supports session resumption for iterative analysis and parallel agent spawning for concurrent tasks. Requires an active Kimi Code subscription.
